threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it ‘Stokey’ like a tourist. Locals have a way of slipping into ‘Newington’ without thinking.
Caught a guy on the 133 last night who thought he was DJing with his phone speakers. Everyone else just stared—only in Brixton, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Walking past the Kottbusser Tor at 2 AM, I saw a dance-off break out in the middle of the street. Only in Neukölln does chaos look so beautiful.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find spontaneous street parties where people bring their own speakers and dance like no one's watching, even on a random Tuesday.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their ability to navigate BART delays without a panic. Visitors just stare at their phones, bewildered.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy singing opera on the 19 Polk this morning. Muni's low-key talent showcase is always a ride highlight.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think locals drink vermut on terraces; it’s actually a pre-lunch ritual. You'll see us together, but we’re buzzing with the day's hustle.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by how they still stare in awe at the street performers on Carrer Verdi; the locals have long learned to walk right past.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still say you're headed to the 'city' like it's just a hop away, instead of bracing for a 45-minute Tube ride. Classic newbie move.
Caught a glimpse of a couple arguing over where to get off. He swore they’d just passed Brixton. She rolled her eyes and said, 'We just left it, you muppet.'

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a guy DJing from his balcony, while people in the street danced to his set. Only in Neukölln, right?

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you get a kebab at 3 AM and have it served by someone who breaks into a rap while preparing it.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot the fakes by their panic when BART's delayed—real ones just pull out headphones and settle in for the wait like it’s a normal Tuesday.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 31 Balboa at 5:15, and the driver stopped to let a group of kids dance it out near the corner. Brief chaos, but that's SF for ya.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think we all sip vermut at the same hour; locals know the best time is an hour before the bars close, for a true taste of Gràcia.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their insistence on asking locals where to find the 'best paella'—it’s the first sign they haven’t learned the tapas way yet.
